attestations.text: Wu Chien-jên 趼人 (繭人), or by his pen-name Wo-fo shan-jên 我佛山人 (Buddha's Hermit), which by a clever pun may be read as Wo Fo-shan jên (I am a native of Fo-shan). Apparently he went to Shanghai early in the 1890's and took up the writing of short stories and novels which appeared in various local newspapers and magazines.
